sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Use the already installed original-root Vitest4.1.11 with explicit Node24.19.0. No dependency installation or source-tree writes.

Minimal Node capsule omits mobile setupFiles (IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT only), react-test-renderer warning filtering, broad TS/TSX collection and oxc.tsconfig=false. Closure has no React/TSX/app aliases and no tsconfig is staged. This is not whole-mobile config or typecheck equivalence.
All six original assertion bodies and seven runtime test/module files are unchanged; type-only imports are erased, not replaced with product stubs.
isolationRationale: Root read the entire test and stream manager plus all five transitive runtime modules. Only Vitest, in-memory maps/deferred Promises, binary decoders and pure unsubscribe builders. Original tests inject sendFrame/waitForConnected and never open sockets, devices, files, credentials, subprocesses or model providers. Preserve all original assertions and MIT notice; minimal config is not a security sandbox.
contract: S-M3 source baseline for RPC error, wait rejection, failed send, queued cancellation, cleared session and throwing error listener. Does not test successful method-specific server cleanup, end-listener throws, real reconnect, E2EE or rewritten-product parity.
